title: Design System: Tatarverse
summary: Bilingual cultural-center catalog with a controlled homepage brand layer and a quiet neutral catalog layer, themed by a user-chosen accent across light and dark.

layers.name: Brand layer
layers.purpose: Homepage identity moments: liquid-metal mark, heavy uppercase hero title, accent-tinted hero word, compact animated stats, and search screenshot imagery.

layers.name: Catalog layer
layers.purpose: Centers list, detail pages, MDX content, filters, search, navigation, translation surfaces, and source-backed factual content.

layers.name: Appearance layer
layers.purpose: User-controlled presentation: theme (system/light/dark), accent preset (green/blue/violet), and a motion on/off toggle. Applied as `.dark`, `[data-accent]`, and `[data-motion]` on <html> by an inline script in Layout.astro <head> before first paint.

rules: Never hardcode a hue. Ship only `--color-*` tokens (`accent`, `accent-vivid`, `accent-glow`, `foreground`, `surface`, `border`, `depth-*`), so a surface survives all three accent presets in both themes.
The accent is a signal — hero word, focus ring, active state — not a general palette. Neutrals carry the catalog.
Every new color must be authored twice: a light value in `@theme` and a dark value under `.dark` in src/styles/tailwind.css. Contrast floors: >=4.5:1 for small UI, >=3:1 for display type.
Use real interface imagery when explaining product behavior.
Preserve locale routes, source links, stable slugs, and factual copy.

Every animated component needs two escape paths, not one: `prefers-reduced-motion` and the user toggle `[data-motion="off"]`. The toggle kills animation and transition globally, so never rely on `transitionend`/`animationend` firing without an explicit 1ms carve-out.

colorMeta.source: src/styles/tailwind.css — light values in `@theme`, dark overrides under `.dark`, accent presets under `[data-accent]` / `.dark[data-accent]`. That file is the single source of truth; `canonical` below is the light value and `dark` the paired one.

background.usage: Page background and default clean plane.

foreground.usage: Primary text, high hierarchy, strong links, and active catalog states.

muted.usage: Low-emphasis surfaces, chips, and catalog cards.

subtleForeground.usage: Footer, filter captions, and quiet metadata. The light value is 46% and not 56% on purpose: 56% lands at 3.24:1 on white, below the AA floor for body text. Do not lighten it.

surface.usage: Cards, menus, MDX surfaces, controls, and screenshot blocks. In dark it sits above `background`, not below.

border.usage: Borders, separators, and quiet content framing.

primary.usage: Primary actions, active filters, and strongest text. Inverts with the theme — pair with `primary-foreground`, never with a literal white or black.

accent.usage: Focus rings, active states, and the homepage hero word. Green is the default preset. Held at >=4.5:1 on its own background in every preset/theme pair — treat these six values as contrast-audited and do not retune one in isolation.

accentVivid.usage: Display-scale type only (hero lines), where WCAG allows 3:1. Never on small UI.

accentGlow.usage: Source tone for the hero `drop-shadow` halo (`--animate-hero-pulse`). Decorative only, never load-bearing for text contrast.

shade.usage: Shadows. Black in both themes — vary opacity, not lightness (denser on dark). Never derive a shadow from `foreground`: it goes near-white in dark and the shadow glows.

depth.usage: Rings, tonal hierarchy, inset lines, metadata, and quiet separation. The 100→700 ramp runs light→dark in light theme and inverts in dark; always reference the step (`depth-300`), never a raw value.

display.purpose: Heavy uppercase homepage hero lines only.
display.fontFamily: 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

headline.purpose: Major page titles and high-level catalog surfaces.
headline.fontFamily: 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

body.purpose: Readable factual content, MDX prose, center summaries, and supporting copy.
body.fontFamily: 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

label.purpose: Compact controls, chips, metadata, stats labels, and navigation.
label.fontFamily: 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

shadows.name: soft-surface-lift
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for cards, controls, MDX panels, and menu surfaces.

motion.name: hero-accent-flow
motion.purpose: Slow homepage accent movement on the highlighted hero word.

motion.name: stats-focus
motion.purpose: Short focus and count animation for catalog scale stats.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Small hover, focus, and active-state feedback.

motion.name: hero-pulse
motion.purpose: Accent-tinted drop-shadow halo breathing around the hero word.

motion.name: hero-gray-drift
motion.purpose: Quiet background-position drift on the hero's second line.

motion.name: drawer-in / drawer-out
motion.purpose: Mobile drawer and its backdrop. Asymmetric in/out curves, so these are animations rather than transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Animated components must provide a reduced-motion path via `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.

motion.name: motion-toggle
motion.purpose: Second, independent off switch: the header appearance menu writes `[data-motion="off"]` on <html> (localStorage key `motion`, values on/off, default on). It forces `animation: none` and `transition: none` on every element and `scroll-behavior: auto`, killing hero, mark, marquee, and hovers while leaving colors and gradients intact. Any component whose state machine waits on `animationend`/`transitionend` must be carved out and given `animation-duration: 1ms` instead of `none` — the drawer (`[data-menu-list]`, `[data-menu-backdrop]`) is the existing precedent. Design and QA every animated surface in all three states: motion on, toggle off, OS reduced-motion.

components.name: Liquid-Metal Mark
components.description: Compact homepage identity object. It stays decorative, centered, and separate from catalog component language.

components.name: Hero Title
components.description: Heavy uppercase localized hero lines with one accent-tinted phrase and quieter secondary lines. The accent tone follows the user's preset and theme.
components.html: Catalog phrase
components.css: .hero-title { font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; text-wrap: balance; } .hero-title__accent { color: var(--color-accent-vivid); }

components.name: Catalog Stats
components.description: Three compact stat pills with icons, tabular numbers, muted labels, and a brief focus animation.
components.html:

Centers
components.css: .stats-focus__item { border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-depth-100) 60%, transparent); }

components.name: Search Screenshot Section
components.description: Localized product-image section using real search screenshots beside concise explanatory copy.
components.html:
Search title

Search copy
components.css: .search-feature { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-shade) 10%, transparent); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary action for clear navigation or active commands.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #ffffff); padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 14px/1.25 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet navigation action used in header and mobile menu links.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 14px/1.25 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d) 5%, transparent); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact filter control with a clear active state.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; max-width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-muted, #f0f0f0); color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #6b6b6b); padding: 6px 10px; font: 500 14px/1.25 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-filter-chip[data-active='true'] { background: var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #ffffff); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Primary catalog search field with soft ring and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-search input { width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-surface-foreground, #1d1d1d); padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 14px/1.25 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-depth-100, #e6e6e6); outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-subtle-foreground, #8f8f8f); } .ds-search input:focus { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #1d1d1d) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Center Card
components.description: Signature catalog list item for center pages. It keeps title, type, category, location, and summary readable in a quiet neutral surface.
components.css: .ds-center-card { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 32px; background: var(--color-muted, #f0f0f0); color: var(--color-surface-foreground, #1d1d1d); padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-depth-100, #e6e6e6) 40%, transparent); } .ds-center-card h3 { overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--color-surface-foreground, #1d1d1d); font: 700 16px/1.375 'Twemoji Country Flags', 'Tatarverse Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; }

components.description: Readable factual prose surface with typography tokens, restrained border, and quiet lift.

narrative.overview: Tatarverse pairs a memorable homepage identity with a quiet, practical catalog. The homepage may use the liquid-metal mark, heavy uppercase hero type, an accent-tinted hero phrase, compact animated stats, and real interface imagery. Catalog surfaces remain neutral, factual, and easy to scan. Presentation is the user's: three accent presets, light/dark, and a motion toggle, so no surface may assume one fixed hue or one fixed theme.
keyCharacteristics: Two-layer system: homepage brand layer plus catalog utility layer.
Neutral semantic tokens carry most interface structure; both themes are authored, never derived.
The user-chosen accent stays a signal: hero phrase, focus ring, active state.
Squircle geometry for controls, cards, stats, menus, and catalog primitives.
Real product imagery in the homepage search section.
Motion limited to identity, stats emphasis, and small control feedback.

rules.name: Neutrals Carry Structure
rules.body: Default to semantic neutral tokens for layout, controls, content, and catalog surfaces.

rules.name: The Accent Is A Signal
rules.body: The accent belongs to the homepage identity moment, focus, and active state only — and it is whichever preset the user picked, so it is only ever referenced as `var(--color-accent)` / `accent-vivid` / `accent-glow`.

rules.name: Display Is Scarce
rules.body: Heavy uppercase display type is for homepage identity and rare page-level statements.

rules.name: Cards Are Functional
rules.body: Use cards for center records, posts, MDX surfaces, and real grouped data.

rules.name: Motion Must Have A Reason
rules.body: Motion is allowed for identity, stats emphasis, and small state feedback, and must survive both off switches: OS reduced-motion and the header `[data-motion="off"]` toggle.

dos: Reuse src/styles/tailwind.css tokens before adding visual roles.
Keep the homepage brand layer distinct from catalog utility surfaces.
Use real product imagery where it clarifies a feature.
Preserve source-backed content, locale routes, stable slugs, and metadata behavior.
Verify contrast for muted labels, placeholders, metadata, and small controls in both themes.
Keep both motion escape paths in every animated component: `prefers-reduced-motion` and `[data-motion="off"]`.
Author every new color twice — light in `@theme`, dark under `.dark` — and check it against all three accent presets.
donts: Do not turn the whole site into the accent hue, and never hardcode one — the user can switch it to green, blue, or violet at any moment.
Do not add extra cultural palettes or ornamental motifs.
Do not add glossy SaaS gradients, glass panels, side stripes, or generic icon-card grids.
Do not reuse homepage display treatment inside dense catalog surfaces.
Do not add decorative motion to MDX pages, lists, or center detail content.
Do not rewrite factual copy into slogans.
Do not hardcode a hex, `bg-white`, `text-black`, or a Tailwind palette color (`zinc-*`, `blue-*`) — they break dark theme and the accent presets.
Do not derive shadows from `foreground`, and do not gate a component's state machine on `transitionend` without a `[data-motion="off"]` carve-out.
